integrity: The theorem was reconstructed from the stated source theorems and a direct ergodic-decomposition proof. No numerical or external certification claim is made.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes a C^infinity nonsingular positive-entropy flow on a compact three-manifold and does not compute the rotational periods or treat general potentials. A residual folklore risk remains because the final time-map classification is elementary once the Bernoulli-period structure is available.
title: Arithmetic resonance dichotomy for maximal-entropy measures of three-dimensional flow time maps
